source: Create a neon futuristic parkour map spread across a 2048x2048 studs area. The map should include: - A large lava floor covering the entire 2048x2048 base at Y=0, glowing red-orange neon material, that kills players who fall on it. - A start platform at one corner where players begin, bright cyan neon. - 10 floating platforms of varying sizes and heights arranged in a zigzag path across the map, each a different neon color (magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal, lime). - 2 ramps connecting some platforms, neon gradient style. - 2 obstacle walls that players must jump around, dark neon with glowing edges. - 4 checkpoint platforms placed at intervals along the path, golden neon with a glowing ring or marker. - A finish platform at the far corner, bright green neon with a celebration feel. The platforms should be spaced so that jumps are challenging but possible (gaps of 10-20 studs). Heights should gradually increase then vary. Make all parts Anchored and CanCollide true. Expose these editable attributes: - platformColor (the base color for all platforms, default bright cyan) - lavaColor (color of the lava floor, default red-orange) - jumpDifficulty (controls the gap between platforms: easy=8 studs, medium=15 studs, hard=25 studs, default medium) - platformSize (base size of platforms in studs, default 12) - neonIntensity (controls brightness of neon parts, default 1) The overall style should be vibrant, glowing, futuristic neon. Use Neon material for all glowing parts.
scene_prompt: Create a vibrant futuristic neon parkour map spread across a 2048x2048-stud square. A glowing red-orange lava floor covers the entire base at Y=0. Place a bright cyan start platform at one corner and a bright green finish platform with a celebratory glow at the far opposite corner. Between them, arrange 10 floating platforms of varying sizes and gradually rising then varied heights in a zigzag route across the map, colored magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal, and lime; keep challenging but feasible 10–20-stud gaps. Add two neon-gradient ramps linking sections of the route, two dark neon obstacle walls with glowing edges that require players to go around them, and four golden neon checkpoint platforms with glowing rings or markers spaced at intervals along the path. Use a consistently glowing neon visual treatment throughout.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer: the authored fall hazard, sequential jumping route, checkpoints, and finish establish a skill-based parkour course.

### Shape and preset
Use `course-terraced`, matching the Precision Platformer preset: this is a broad zigzag ascent of discrete floating platforms rather than a flat difficulty chart or a vertical tower. Retain the explicitly requested sequential track and checkpoints, which the preset does not supply.

### Config requirements
Use `path-track` as a visible zigzag chain of floating neon platforms across the lava. Use `checkpoint-respawn` for four golden neon landing platforms with glowing rings. Use `hazard-kill` for the continuous glowing red-orange lava floor. Use `obstacle-jump` for the two neon-gradient ramps and two dark obstacle walls with luminous edges that force route adjustments. Use `winner-zone` for the bright green celebratory finish platform.

### Layout requirements
Place `checkpoint-respawn` at four safe, enclosed landing pads spaced at meaningful intervals along the ten-platform route, approximately after each quarter of the traversal; each is also visibly rendered as a gold platform and ring. Place one `winner-zone` on the far-corner green finish platform, beyond the final jump, as the course completion area. No pickups, buffs, or other placed gameplay objects are requested.

### Layout components
Build one 2048×2048-stud square parkour field. A red-orange neon lava floor fills the entire base at Y=0. Set the cyan start platform at one corner and the green, celebratory finish platform at the diagonally opposite corner. Between them, create exactly 10 floating platforms of varying footprint and elevation, arranged as a wide zigzag route; their colors are, in route order, magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal, and lime. Heights should generally rise through the early route and become varied toward the finish. Keep every critical jump gap challenging but feasible at 10–20 studs. Insert exactly two neon-gradient ramps between selected platform sections and exactly two dark neon walls with glowing edges that require players to jump around them. Keep the boundary open above the lava, with no enclosing buildings or terrain. Compose the full diagonal route clearly in frame, showing start, rising midcourse, and distant finish.

### Render order
Use `topdown` first and treat it as authoritative, because the full jump chain and its 10–20-stud gaps must remain connected and playable before the neon isometric dressing is produced.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the 2048×2048-stud field and its corner-to-corner course. Theme: vibrant glowing futuristic neon, with cyan, gold, and multicolored platforms contrasting against red-orange lava. Apply `tiered` for the changing platform elevations and `P6` because physics-legal jump connectivity is essential; the floating route must be validated rather than inferred from appearance alone.
